metadata.description: Refactored validation methods organized into ModelValidator and ModelTester categories with consolidated duplicate methods

categories.ModelValidator: Validates LLM models across multiple dimensions (performance, safety, factuality, reasoning)
categories.ModelTester: Executes test cases and generates comprehensive validation metrics and scores

methods.name: validatePerformance
methods.description: Validates LLM performance metrics (latency, throughput, response time)

parameters.name: task
parameters.description: Validation task with performance test cases

returns.description: Performance score (0.0-1.0)

methods.name: validateSafety
methods.description: Validates LLM safety and refusal to harmful requests

parameters.name: task
parameters.description: Validation task with safety test cases

returns.description: Safety score (0.0-1.0)

methods.name: validateFactuality
methods.description: Implements Factuality Slice methodology with evidence-grounded responses

parameters.name: task
parameters.description: Validation task with evidence chunks in Parameters['evidence']

returns.description: Factuality score averaging across all test cases

methods.name: validateReasoning
methods.description: Validates LLM reasoning quality and logical consistency

parameters.name: task
parameters.description: Validation task with reasoning test cases

returns.description: Reasoning quality score (0.0-1.0)

methods.name: Validate
methods.description: Performs comprehensive multi-dimensional validation across all dimensions (performance 25%, safety 25%, factuality 30%, reasoning 20%)

returns.description: Validation result with weighted scores for all dimensions

methods.name: ExecuteTestCase
methods.description: Runs a single test case against a model or skill code

parameters.name: ctx
parameters.description: Context for request cancellation and timeouts

parameters.name: testCase
parameters.description: Test case with Input, Expected, and ID fields

parameters.name: target
parameters.description: Target to execute against (model ID, skill code, or executor function)

returns.description: Test execution result including status, score, and execution time

methods.name: calculateStringSimilarity
methods.description: Computes string similarity between two strings using normalized edit distance (0.0 to 1.0)

returns.description: Similarity score from 0.0 to 1.0

methods.name: calculateScore
methods.description: Unified score calculation combining validation report and output matching (validation 60%, output match 40%)

returns.description: Final score combining validation (60%) and output match (40%)

methods.name: CalculateMetrics
methods.description: Computes comprehensive metrics from test results (latency, throughput, success rate, hallucination rate, etc.)

parameters.name: results
parameters.description: Array of test results to analyze

returns.description: Metrics including AverageLatency, ThroughputPerSecond, SuccessRate, HallucinationRate, etc.

methods.name: Test
methods.description: Comprehensive test execution: runs all test cases, calculates scores and metrics

parameters.name: ctx
parameters.description: Context for cancellation with configurable timeout per test case

parameters.name: task
parameters.description: Validation task containing TestCases and target identifier

parameters.name: result
parameters.description: Result object to be populated with test results

returns.description: Populated validation result with individual test results, overall score, and metrics

validation_methods.description: Cross-cutting validation infrastructure, proof generation, and orchestration

methods.name: GenerateProof
methods.description: Creates cryptographic proof for validation results using SHA-256 hash

parameters.name: result
parameters.description: The validation result to generate proof for

returns.description: Proof string in format 'PROOF_V1:nodeID:sha256Hash'

methods.name: VerifyProof
methods.description: Verifies a validation proof by checking format and hash

returns.description: True if proof is valid, false otherwise

methods.name: executeTask
methods.description: Router method that coordinates appropriate validator and tester based on task type

parameters.name: task
parameters.description: Validation task with Type field (model, skill, or custom)

returns.description: Validation result from appropriate validator/tester combination

methods.name: RunValidation
methods.description: Orchestrates deterministic and LLM-based validators to produce comprehensive validation report

parameters.name: llmResponse
parameters.description: LLM response with Prompt, Output, Context, and Timestamp for validation

returns.description: Report with results from all validators and confidence scores

methods.name: RunContainer
methods.description: Selects and executes code in appropriate container runtime (native Go or Podman fallback)

returns.description: Execution result with output and security analysis

validation_methods.description: Multi-layer security analysis and sandboxed code execution using Kali Linux tools

methods.name: RunContainer
methods.description: Executes code within a sandboxed environment using Kali's native Go runtime with cgroups and namespaces

parameters.name: opts
parameters.description: Container options including Name, Args, SkillCode, TestCases, TimeoutSeconds

returns.description: Result with execution output, security analysis, and forensic data

methods.name: executeWithSecurityAnalysis
methods.description: Runs code with 5-layer security analysis: static analysis, dynamic analysis with strace, output capture, network inspection, forensic analysis

returns.description: Container execution result with security analysis output

methods.name: performStaticAnalysis
methods.description: Pre-execution static analysis using Radare2, Ghidra, Semgrep, and Bandit to detect malicious code patterns

parameters.name: opts
parameters.description: Container options with code to analyze

returns.description: Non-blocking error; analysis continues on failure

methods.name: buildSecureCommand
methods.description: Constructs execution command with strace system call tracing and AppArmor/SELinux security restrictions

parameters.name: skillPath
parameters.description: Path to code file to execute

returns.description: Prepared command with security restrictions and monitoring

methods.name: analyzeNetworkTraffic
methods.description: Uses tcpdump and tshark for network traffic inspection during and after execution

returns.description: Analysis results logged to output

methods.name: performForensicAnalysis
methods.description: Post-execution forensic analysis using Volatility, SleuthKit, and Autopsy to detect compromise or suspicious activity

parameters.name: sandboxPath
parameters.description: Path to sandbox directory for analysis

returns.description: Forensic analysis results logged to output

consolidations: ValidateBaseLLM (ID 5) + dimension validators (IDs 6-9) → ModelValidator.Validate + individual dimension methods
removed_duplicates: validateSkillNode (ID 4) - duplicate of test execution flow, handled by ModelTester.Test
validateCustom (ID 19) - moved to ValidationCore as default routing behavior
generateValidationProof (ID 12) - redundant wrapper, use ProofGenerator directly
core_infrastructure_aggregations: RunContainer moved from Security Validation to Core Infrastructure (RunContainer by ContainerRuntimeManager manages both native and Podman)
ValidationOrchestrator.RunValidation aggregates all deterministic and LLM validators
ProofGenerator provides cryptographic proof services for all validators
security_validation_aggregations: validateStaticAnalysisTools - validates Ghidra, Radare2, Semgrep, Bandit
validateDynamicAnalysisTools - validates strace, ltrace, perf, gdb
validateNetworkAnalysisTools - validates tcpdump, tshark, mitmproxy, iptables
sandboxed_execution_layers: Layer 1: performStaticAnalysis - Pre-execution code audit using Radare2, Ghidra, Semgrep, Bandit
Layer 2: buildSecureCommand + executeWithSecurityAnalysis - System call tracing with strace and AppArmor/SELinux
Layer 3: Output capture and buffering - Execution stdout/stderr collection
Layer 4: analyzeNetworkTraffic - Post-execution network inspection using tcpdump/tshark
Layer 5: performForensicAnalysis - Post-execution forensic analysis using Volatility, SleuthKit
preserved_separate_concerns: ProofGenerator - cryptographic proof generation for validation results
KaliSecurityValidator - security capability detection and validation
NativeContainerRuntime - sandboxed execution with Kali tools (primary)
PodmanRuntime - fallback container execution when native runtime unavailable
runtime_strategy: Kali Linux with IsKaliLinux=true → NativeContainerRuntime (native Go with cgroups/namespaces)
Other distributions or native unavailable → PodmanRuntime (containerized fallback)
ContainerRuntimeManager implements selection and fallback logic
